page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew and Aramaic words mixed in; no marginal notes of text in the margins apart from faint show-through, which is left out. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: נבש Ch. Congregare, Comportare, Partic. נבשא בחצרא מיכלה Comportat in messe cibū suum, Prov.6.8. Sunt qui legunt נרשא.
נבת גיבתא Calamus, Canalis: vel Pixis, pixidicula, Esth.1.3. in Targ.sec.
נגר Syre ܢܓܪ Guttur, Hebr. גרון. Plural. cum Aff. ܓܪܘܗܝ Guttura eorum, ad Rom.3.13.

נר גרא Ch.Sidus fauftum, cujus virtute prospera eveniunt, Fortuna bona. Sic accipiunt illud Genef.30.11. בנר quasi fit בא גר Venit fortuna bona.Onkel.& T.Hierof.Hebraeum retinuerunt. Jonath.autem מולא טבא transtulit. Sunt qui interpretantur בגר Per Deum., per Jovem, quod Juppiter planeta fit Benignus. Hinc illud Jesa.65.11. העורכים לגד שלחן Arias Montanus reddidit, Parantes Jovi mensam. Atque hinc vocem Germanicam Gott derivatam nonnulli volunt: quo accedit & Persarum כורא, quomodo Deum appellare solent.
תגרא Ch: Vide in littera ת.
גזברין Ch. Dispensatores, Oeconomi, qui culinae seu victualibus praesunt, Eccles.2.7. Alias etiam dicuntur גזברין.
גרך Ch. Exscidit, Succidit, Imper. גרו איולנא Succidite arborem, Dan.4.11. Hebr. גזו.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are rendered as printed as far as legible; several vowel-pointed words are approximate. The final line נדורין is a catchword-like word at the foot, right. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
